name: Diginius
summary: Digital marketing and e-commerce performance platform. Manage PPC, analytics and product feeds to improve online sales and visibility.
best_for: lean teams and agencies that want PPC, SEO and lead intelligence consolidated in one affordable dashboard instead of five subscriptions
skip_if: your growth lives in one channel where a specialist tool's depth pays for itself, or you need enterprise analytics rigor
honest_knock: Marketing dashboards that bundle many tools live or die on data depth per module. Diginius bundles PPC, SEO, lead intelligence and reporting affordably, but specialists (a dedicated SEO suite, a dedicated PPC optimizer) go deeper in their lanes. So buy it as consolidation for a lean team, not as a replacement for expert-grade tooling in your primary channel. Verify the integrations you depend on (especially Microsoft Ads, its historical strength) in the trial.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-11-27 on diginius.com/pricing/, business pricing; first re-verified 2026-09-22) Essential $75 USD a month, Pro $250, Core $500 and marked Most Popular, Business by contact with sales. The amounts are unchanged since our 21 August 2026 reading. The FAQ on the same page confirms a 20% discount for annual payment and says there is no time limit on the Essential package. Users are published again, as Unlimited on every plan, next to Account Integrations: Unlimited. On 21 August 2026 the page sold Essential as 2 users, Pro as 5 and Core as 10, and on 22 September 2026 it named no seat count at all. The plan limits scale with the price: SEO keywords 25 / 500 / 1000 / custom, SEO site pages 1000 / 5000 / 10000 / custom, Lead Intelligence leads 10 / 50 / 100 a week (10 / 25 / 50 on 22 September), Bombora intent leads 10 / 50 / 100 a week and contact info credits 25 / 50 / 100 a month. The desktop table and the mobile plan cards now agree: both say weekly for Lead Intelligence, both give Essential a 30-day trial and both give Core a Dedicated CS Rep. In September the mobile cards said monthly, 14 days and email support. Support runs from email only on Essential to a Customer Success Rep on Pro and a Dedicated CS Rep on Core and Business. The trial banner advertises 30 days including 100 intent leads a week and 100 contact credits, after which your plan limits apply.
